Read in the order the factors appear in the display just above (S/2, then 2^{2-2alpha^2}D, then N^{-1}/2), the bounds would give 7/8 to the D factor and 1 to the N^{-1} factor. errors.quote: moving an axis past a neighbour is a [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-chunk-interchange.md) of $\ell$- or $(\ell-1)$-bit fields, costing $O(Tp(1+\ell^\tau))$
errors.problem: The chunk-swap lemma interchanges fields of equal width only. When t_i=r meets t_j=r/2, the fields have widths ell and ell-1. The paper splits the longer field into a leading bit plus ell-1 bits, swaps the equal-width pieces, and moves the single bit with the elementary-stream primitive. The cost bound is unchanged.
